trust.model: trust is removed, not given — each engine kills one specific belief that blocks the buy
trust.doctrine: free at SCALE (1-to-many broadcast content, costs nothing extra). NEVER free at 1:1 (audits, decks, strategy calls) — that is where extraction happens
trust.hard_rule_kept: R2 — no free audit before YES. Validated by the Omar thread, not by preference
trust.why_free_is_not_enough: In 2026 free value is not scarce. Every competitor in this niche gives away 100+ niches, 300+ prompts, full AI stacks and workflows for free. AI made information worthless, so free information no longer signals anything. What is scarce is a verifiable outcome.

evidence.own_free_audit: Omar (@premiereprotutos, 164K): a full free 6-part audit was delivered Oct 20 (Transition Pack, revenue model, 14-day launch, 3 story scripts). Result: he stalled, then asked for a strategy deck 'for research purposes'. Free work produced extraction, not conversion.
evidence.own_proof_request: Anu (@its.anu.sharma, 222K) asked 'can you show case studies?' — she did not want more free value, she wanted verifiable proof. Proof was the blocker, not generosity.
evidence.skool_freemium: 2-5% free->paid typical on Skool, 8-10% only when highly engaged
evidence.skool_challenge: 8-15% of active members convert via a structured challenge vs 0.3-0.8% via a direct pitch — a 4-6x difference
evidence.hormszi_reference: 4.5% free->paid at 100,000 free members (Hormozi model) — free scales by volume, not by conversion rate
evidence.free_audit_market: free audits attract tire-kickers, are valued less, and devalue execution; a small PAID tripwire credited toward the build converts far better

competitors.youtube_automation_hub: FREE: 'Ultimate Faceless YouTube OS' — 100+ high-RPM niches, full AI stack (research/script/voice/edit/thumb), viral title frameworks, 300+ prompts, automation workflows, monetization playbook. Gated by follow + like + repost + comment 'YT'.
competitors.virovate_academy: FREE: 7-day trial of exact niches, scripts and faceless workflow.
competitors.uploados: $116/week with a 1-day trial — upload automation, templates, weekly Q&A.
competitors.wheellsverse: $47/mo with a 3-day trial — faceless frameworks, AI tools, monthly challenges with prizes.
competitors.benjamin_hubner: FREE Quickstart PDF + referral unlocks, then a low-ticket suite from $17.
competitors.the_gap: All five give away TEMPLATES, PROMPTS or TIME-BOXED ACCESS. Not one of them gives away PROOF. Screenshots are fakeable; a live channel with a public ledger is not. That is the only defensible ground in the niche.

show.name: THE OPEN LEDGER
show.mechanic: Publish the real numbers of all 5 pages every day — views, ER, comments, replies, revenue, churn, and the failures — on a public /proof page fed straight from Neon. 24h lag, nothing hand-edited, no cherry-picking.
show.why_it_wins: An audit can be invented. A channel can be checked. When a prospect can verify the claim before talking to us, the case-study objection (Anu) dies before it is raised.
show.competitor_status: nobody in the niche does this — every competitor shows screenshots

exposure.revenue: admin only by default — every brand or member chooses OPTIONALLY whether to publish their own results and revenue
exposure.opt_in: share_revenue flag per brand; default OFF. Nothing is published on someone's behalf without them turning it on.
exposure.why: publishing someone else's revenue without consent is not transparency, it is a leak. Opt-in keeps the ledger honest AND safe.
exposure.owner_view: owner sees exact revenue for all brands on /money and /ledger?owner=1

cadence.totals_lag: none — cumulative counters only, never a single day
cadence.why: a cumulative total cannot be gamed by picking a good hour; a single day can. So totals feel live and the audited rows stay sealed for 24h.

do.name: THE 14-DAY CHALLENGE
do.kills: 'I don't believe it works in MY niche'
do.mechanic: The existing monthly 14-day sequence becomes a cohort challenge: free to join, one action per day (Warm-Up 1-3 / Value 4-9 / Money 10-14), ending in THEIR OWN 72h demand test. Completion is tracked and ranked.
do.why_it_wins: 8-15% conversion vs 0.3-0.8% for a direct pitch. They trust it because they produced their own result — not because we handed them a PDF. 'Free to join, expensive to finish.'
do.success_metric: completion rate 60%+ is the strongest predictor of upgrade

challenge.name: THE 14-DAY CHALLENGE
challenge.status: LIVE — free to join, one action per day, ends in the member's own 72h demand test
challenge.why_it_converts: 8-15% of active members vs 0.3-0.8% for a direct pitch. They trust it because they produced their own number, not because we explained ours.
challenge.doctrine: free to join, expensive to finish — the work is the qualification

days.action: Audit one rival page in your niche

days.why: comments are the only trusted metric — likes lie

days.action: Write 3 hooks in your own voice
days.why: the hook is the whole product; the video is packaging

days.action: Post 1 piece of value — no ask
days.why: warm-up exists so day 10 does not feel like a jump-scare

days.action: Post again and reply to every comment within 15 min
days.why: the reply is where the buyer is revealed

days.action: Run the comment audit on your own post
days.why: you must be able to read your own signal before you sell

days.action: Post the teardown: what worked, what flopped
days.why: public honesty is the cheapest trust you will ever buy

days.action: Ask your audience one question they answer in one word
days.why: their words become your sales copy verbatim

days.action: Post the best answer back to them as content
days.why: proof you listen, which is rarer than proof you know
Stories only — a feed post poisons the test

days.action: Publish the Stories and start the 72h clock
days.why: 72h is the honest window; longer is a wish

days.action: Reply to every response, log objections
Read the 72h result at the same hour you posted
Decide: build the offer, or fix the niche
days.deliverable: your decision + what you will do next
days.why: the decision is the deliverable, not the revenue

challenge.audience: OPERATORS — people who want to run a page like ours using this system. The challenge is a recruitment and activation funnel, not a product funnel.
challenge.audience_note: A finisher does not just buy a subscription — they become a Shadow Operator running their own page on this stack. That is Phase 2 funding itself.

gate.who: community members only — no public sign-ups
gate.why_tenure: 14 days of membership is the filter money cannot buy: tourists do not stay two weeks and pay for it
gate.entry_note: NO extra charge. The membership IS the ticket. Asking a $26 member for a $28 deposit to join a task would make entry $54 and empty the room.
qualifies: First Shot $28 (14-day all-access pass — those 14 days ARE the tenure)
gate.not_eligible: anyone who is not a paying member, regardless of how badly they want in

verification.method: Jarvis opens the submitted link AND pulls the post's real view/comment count from the platform API
verification.reconcile: compare claimed vs verified; a mismatch above 20% is rejected and the day does not count until corrected
verification.missing_api: if a platform key is absent, the day is marked unverified_api_missing — counted, but flagged and excluded from the leaderboard top 3
verification.never: never silently accept a number. A member who inflates once is warned; twice is removed from the cohort.

non_finishers.what: day 15: offered Lite $17/mo instead of the First Shot
non_finishers.why: they failed the completion standard, so they do not get the premium door — but they are still a paying member, and Lite $17 is 1+7=8
non_finishers.copy: 'You did not finish, so I will not pretend you did. Here is the cheaper door — same tools, one domain, 3/day.'
non_finishers.never: no guilt copy, no third message, no shaming on the board

bet.name: SKIN IN THE GAME
bet.kills: 'I don't believe I'll get my money's worth'
bet.mechanic: The $28 First Shot carries a written guarantee: if the 72h demand test does not reach 50 comments, $28 comes back AND they keep every asset built. The operator carries the risk, not the buyer.
bet.why_it_wins: Risk transfer is the strongest trust signal available and it fits the Life Path 8 posture — confidence, never discounting. It also keeps the paid tripwire (which the market data says beats free) instead of collapsing to a free trial.
bet.cap: guarantee capped at the 72h demand test only — never a satisfaction guarantee on revenue

trust.sequence: SHOW before DO, DO before BET — a stranger must be able to verify before being asked to act, and must have acted before being asked to pay.
never: never a free 1:1 audit, deck or strategy call
never a keyword-comment gate (follow/like/repost/comment 'YT') — it inflates comments and poisons the trusted metric
never a free trial longer than 7 days
never fake or borrowed case studies — niche results do not transfer
trust.env_summary: PROOF_PUBLIC / PROOF_LAG_HOURS / PROOF_INCLUDE_FAILURES / CHALLENGE_COHORT_SIZE / CHALLENGE_MIN_COMPLETION / FIRST_SHOT_GUARANTEE / GUARANTEE_THRESHOLD

learning.purpose: Jarvis improves itself, then the operation, then the money — in that order, and only with evidence.
learning.law: no change without a measured before and after. A hunch may be TESTED, never SHIPPED.
learning.cycle: weekly: observe -> hypothesise -> test 1 variable -> read the result -> promote or kill -> write the playbook
learning.order_why: Self first: a system that cannot correct its own output will scale its mistakes. Each stage only unlocks when the previous one is measurably working.

1_self.what: Jarvis grades its own work against what the market did — hook retention, ER, comment quality, objection rate
1_self.gate_to_next: 3 consecutive cycles where the promoted change beat the incumbent on the same metric
1_self.cannot: cannot grade itself on revenue alone, and cannot promote a change it also scored — WF15 recomputes independently

2_operation.what: The same loop applied to throughput: render pass rate, G4 rejection rate, publish cadence, cost per clip, DQ rate
2_operation.gate_to_next: cost per shipped clip falls for 2 cycles AND G4 rejection below 10%

3_money.what: Then the loop touches pricing, offers, sequences and the save menu — the only stage where money moves
3_money.gate_to_next: a full month above the recommended member floor (53) with churn at or under 2.0%

sample_rules.one_variable: exactly one thing changes per test; two changes and the result is unreadable
sample_rules.holdout: 20% of each page's posts keep the incumbent so the comparison has a control
sample_rules.confidence: a change wins only if it beats the incumbent by more than 10% and does not lose the primary metric

playbook.what: what works, per niche — hooks, lengths, posting times, CTAs, objection answers, thumbnails
playbook.promotion: a tactic enters the playbook after 2 independent wins on 2 different pages
playbook.demotion: a tactic leaves after 2 consecutive losses; it is archived, not deleted, so the same dead idea is not retried
playbook.decay: every tactic re-tested every 60 days — what works in October is not guaranteed in January

learning.writes_to: config/adaptable.json -> learning.promoted (read-only at runtime), Neon playbook table, and the page template used for duplication
learning.autonomy: AUTONOMY_RESEARCH 95% for testing; promoting a tactic into the playbook is automatic; changing a PRICE is never automatic

scaleout.purpose: Prove one page, then duplicate it in parallel — never duplicate an unproven one.
scaleout.law: a page earns the right to be copied. Cloning before proof multiplies losses at the same speed it multiplies wins.

graduation.name: PAGE GRADUATION
must_hold_all: at least 3 paying buyers from that page
cost per shipped clip at or under the plan
graduation.then: the page becomes a TEMPLATE: its prompts, character lock, hook bank, posting times and playbook slice are frozen as a version

duplication.what_copies: template version: master prompt, character lock, hook bank, cadence, playbook slice
duplication.what_never_copies: the audience, the comments, the credibility. A clone starts at zero and is told so publicly
duplication.ramp: 3 live pages maximum until the third one graduates; then 6; then 10 — the cap only lifts on proof, never on ambition
duplication.isolation: one credential set, one R2 prefix, one Buffer channel group and one budget per page — a bad page cannot poison the others
duplication.niche_distance: a new page must be at least 2 niches away from an existing one until the playbook has 5 proven hooks per niche
duplication.kill_rule: a clone that fails its 72h demand test twice is archived, not nursed — the sunk cost is bounded by design

money_model.per_page: one graduating page supports the Circle that funds the tools; the second and third pages are the margin
money_model.portfolio: revenue is read per page, not in aggregate — an average hides a dead page
money_model.reinvest: new pages are funded from graduated pages, never from the owner's pocket
money_model.ceiling: lanes stop at 10 pages because 10 pages x 10 channels is the most one owner can supervise at 80% autonomy

scaleout.autonomy: duplication runs at AUTONOMY_SEQUENCE 85% once a template exists; creating a NEW template needs the owner
